limitations: User reported severe stutter during device demonstration. Functional playback is not performance acceptance.

Diagnostic filter removal, video pause and alternate composition trials did not establish a sufficient performance fix; visual overrides were reverted.
WebKit playback-quality counters were unavailable; no dropped-frame or comparative CPU claim is made.
The native preview used simulated setup actions; no account, password or network settings were changed.
New-user first boot, sanitized image and actual Fastboot installation remain unverified.
